title: Dense Passage Retrieval for Open-Domain Question Answering (DPR)
description: Showed that dense bi-encoder retrieval with in-batch negative training outperforms TF-IDF/BM25 on open-domain QA. Defined the bi-encoder training recipe used in all dense retrievers.
authors: Karpukhin, Oğuz, Min, Lewis, Wu, Edunov, Chen, Yih
